diagnosis: SupportIncidentSitemap iterates over CustomerIncidentPostmortem records where status='RESOLVED' and publishes them to an open XML sitemap. Many resolved incidents contain internal customer outage reports, security vulnerability details, and sensitive system architecture diagrams meant only for the affected corporate client.
exploit_request:
GET /sitemap-incidents.xml HTTP/1.1
Host: status-portal.cloudinfra.com
Accept: application/xml
